en: That's all for now. More is on the way.
zh_TW: 目前的內容到這裡，後面還在做

en: That's all for now. Keep exploring, or return to the title from the pause menu.
zh_TW: 目前的內容到這裡。可以繼續逛，或從暫停選單回標題。

en: You fell. Returning to the last checkpoint…
zh_TW: 你倒下了。回到上一個檢查點……
釋放（把身上的毒炸出去）

en: You're at full health, so you won't see any effect. Drink it anyway?
zh_TW: 現在滿血，看不出效果。還是要喝嗎？
防禦歸零 → 受傷減少

en: These Curses Are Far Too Useful to Me
zh_TW: 這些詛咒對我太有用了

en: My "infection-prone" body turned out to be the cheat that flips everything
zh_TW: 被嫌棄的易感染體質，其實是逆轉一切的外掛

en: Chapter 1: The Tumor and the Junk
zh_TW: 第一章　毒瘤與破爛的共鳴

en: Defeat the poison slimes in the glade
zh_TW: 打倒空地上的劇毒史萊姆
{move} 移動　{sprint} 跑　{look} 轉視角

en: {attack} Attack　{dodge} Dodge　{release} Burst the poison on you
zh_TW: {attack} 攻擊　{dodge} 閃避　{release} 把身上的毒炸出去

en: Every ailment on you flips into a boon.
zh_TW: 落在你身上的異常狀態，全都會反轉成增益。

en: S-slimes! H-hang on, I will back you up!
zh_TW: 史、史萊姆！等、等一下，我來幫你——

en: No no no! Norn, I am so sorry, I messed up again!
zh_TW: 完了完了！諾恩，對不起我又搞砸了！

en: Mask, mask... okay, it is on!
Paralyzed → Faster attacks　Defense zero → Less damage taken
zh_TW: 麻痺 → 出手加速　防禦歸零 → 受傷減少

en: You attack 150% faster, every cut hits that much harder, and you take 80% less damage. Cut them down!
zh_TW: 出手快 150%、每一刀也重 150%，受到的傷害少 80%。趁現在砍！

en: W-wait, that is miasma! Without a mask, normal people collapse in ten minutes!
zh_TW: 等、等一下，那是瘴氣！沒戴面具進去，普通人十分鐘就會倒下的！

en: Funny. I feel better than I have all week.
zh_TW: 奇怪。我覺得這是我這禮拜精神最好的一次。

en: ...Y-you are glowing gold. Does poison just... not work on you?
zh_TW: ……你、你身上在發金光耶。毒對你……沒有用嗎？

en: Looks like it does more than nothing. Come on. Keep that mask on and stay behind me.
zh_TW: 好像不只是沒用。走吧，妳面具戴好，跟在我後面。

en: U-um! You are the one who took the toxic mushroom request at the guild... right?
zh_TW: 那、那個！你是在公會接下毒蕈委託的人……對吧？

en: That is me. And you are?
I-I am Sera, an apprentice alchemist. ...The one everybody avoids. The side effects of my potions are stronger than the potions.
zh_TW: 我、我叫席菈，見習鍊金術師。……就是大家在躲的那個。我做的藥，副作用都比藥效還強。

en: Um... my potions do have side effects, but in a place full of poison mist, they might actually be useful... Could I come with you?
zh_TW: 那個……雖然我的藥水有副作用，但如果是去毒霧區，說不定能派上用場……能讓我跟你一起去嗎？

en: Sure. Walking alone is boring anyway.
Side effects stronger than the potion? Now I want to try one.
zh_TW: 副作用比藥效還強？我反而想試試看。

en: R-really!? Thank you! I have a gas mask, so I can handle the miasma. I will not slow you down!
zh_TW: 真、真的可以嗎！？謝謝你！我有防毒面具，瘴氣我撐得住，不會拖累你的！

en: Y-you want to try one!? People usually run when they hear that...! I have a gas mask for the miasma, and you can have all the potions you want!
zh_TW: 咦、你想試！？大家聽到都是用跑的耶……！我有防毒面具，瘴氣我撐得住——藥要多少有多少！

en: I-I am so sorry! I grabbed the wrong vial again... Huh? You are... fine?
zh_TW: 對、對不起！我又拿錯瓶了……咦？你……沒事？

en: Fine? That was the best thing anyone has ever shot at me.
zh_TW: 沒事。應該說，那是我這輩子挨過最棒的一發。

en: Norn... you really do not get hurt by what I make?
zh_TW: 諾恩……你真的不會因為我的能力而受傷嗎？

en: Never. To me, your failures are the best medicine there is.
zh_TW: 不會。妳的失敗作，對我來說是最好的藥。

en: It only startles me. Shout before you shoot next time.
zh_TW: 只是會嚇一跳。下次射之前先喊一聲。

en: ...Nobody has ever said that to me. Th-then I will make lots more!
zh_TW: ……第一次有人這樣說。那、那我之後多做一點！

en: O-okay! I will shout! ...So, um, you will still let me shoot you?
zh_TW: 好、好的！我會喊的！……那個，所以你還願意讓我射？

en: Poisons whoever drinks it for 20 seconds.
